ai_instructions: This is the AccelHealth Patient Registration form. Collect all required fields conversationally and warmly. Gender identity and sexual orientation sections are optional for patients under 18 — present them but make clear they are optional. The parent/guardian section only applies if the patient is a minor. SSN, signature, and age are collected at the review step.

fields.label: Last Name
fields.question: What is your last name?

fields.label: First Name
fields.question: What is your first name?

fields.label: Middle Name
fields.question: What is your middle name? Say 'skip' if you don't have one.

es.question: ¿Cuál es su segundo nombre? Diga 'omitir' si no tiene.
es.label: Segundo nombre

fields.label: Social Security Number
fields.ai_note: Sensitive — collected at review step, not during voice intake.
fields.question: What is your Social Security Number?

es.question: ¿Cuál es su número de seguro social?
